title: Chapter 08: Gateway Coordination Protocol (GCP)
description: Spec: spec/08-gateway-coordination.md. Multi-gateway coordination protocol covering trust models (PSK/signatures), discovery, RPL multi-instance, TDMA slot coordination, and node handoff. Builds on RPL multi-instance (RFC 6550 §5), adapted 6TiSCH concepts for LoRa, and OSCORE security.
